summary: Unsaved warning popup not showing in Notes Tab
description:
*Issue*: Unsaved warning popup not showing in Notes Tab

*Steps to Reproduce*:

# Go to CRM Integration → Salesforce
# Click on "Notes" tab
# Make any configuration change (toggle sync, check/uncheck options)
# Click on any other tab (Organizations, Accounts, Contacts, Activities, etc.)
# *Expected*: Warning popup "You have unsaved changes" should appear
# *Actual*: No warning popup, changes are lost

*Additional Test Scenarios*:

* Try switching between "IN" and "OUT" side tabs within Notes
* Try switching between "Note type configuration" and other side tabs
* Try switching between different entity tabs (Organizations → Accounts → Notes)

*Environment*:

* Salesforce integration
* Any browser
* Any user role

*Screenshots/Videos*:

* [ ] Screenshot of making changes in Notes tab
* [ ] Screenshot of switching tabs without warning
* [ ] Screenshot of expected warning popup (from other tabs)

*Comparison*:

* Activities tab shows warning popup correctly
* Organizations tab shows warning popup correctly
* Notes tab should behave the same way
